Direct Mail Associations, Memberships & Affiliations

Active memberships in Hudson Valley business organizations, national postal associations, and industry groups since 1998.

Sean Griffin

President, Cornerstone Services, Inc. · USPS® Mail Design Professional · MSMA™ Certified

Cornerstone has maintained active memberships in Hudson Valley business and postal associations since 1998 as part of its commitment to regional community and industry standards.

BBB A+ Rating

Cornerstone Services, Inc. holds an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau — the highest rating the BBB issues. We have maintained continuous BBB accreditation since 1998 with no unresolved complaints. The A+ rating reflects our commitment to transparent pricing, responsive service, and ethical business practices across every direct mail and printing project we handle.

BBB accreditation is not automatic — businesses must meet the BBB's Standards for Trust, which include commitment to making a good faith effort to resolve consumer complaints, honesty in advertising, and transparency in business dealings. Our 27-year track record with the BBB speaks directly to how we operate.

View our BBB profile →

National and Industry Associations

Beyond local chamber memberships, Cornerstone holds active memberships in national postal and industry organizations. These affiliations provide access to USPS regulatory updates, professional certification programs, and industry best practices that directly benefit our EDDM, direct mail, and data services clients.

Mail Systems Management Association (MSMA)

National association for mail management professionals. MSMA certification validates expertise in mail operations, postal regulations, and mail center management.

msmanational.org →

Greater Hudson Valley Postal Customer Council (GHV PCC)

A partnership between the U.S. Postal Service and the mailing industry. The PCC provides education, networking, and direct access to USPS operational updates for commercial mailers.

SUNY New Paltz and Local College Affiliations

Cornerstone Services provides internship opportunities to SUNY New Paltz and other local college students in business, marketing, and computer science. Located minutes from the SUNY New Paltz campus, our facility gives students hands-on experience in direct mail production, data processing, and print operations — skills that complement their academic programs and prepare them for careers in marketing and communications.
